examples.arabic: لحد ما يصير هاد، الناس هون عم يثبتوا إنو الحياة بتكمل بالحب والتعاون.
examples.english: Until that happens, the people here are proving that life continues with love and cooperation.
examples.transliteration: La-hadd ma ysir hada, el-naas haun am yit-hbitu innu el-hayat btikammel bel-hubb wal-ta-awun.
examples.storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

examples.arabic: انا موظف جديد هون وشغلي ببلش بكير
examples.english: I am a new employee here and my work starts early.
examples.transliteration: ana mowazzaf jdeed hon w shoghli bballesh bakeer

examples.arabic: نحن منشم الورد الاحمر الحلو هون
examples.english: We smell the sweet red roses here.
examples.transliteration: nihna mnesham al ward al ahmar al hilo hon

examples.arabic: هي بدها عرس جديد هون ببيت كبير
examples.english: She wants a new wedding here in a big house.
examples.transliteration: Hiyye baddaha 'arus jdeed hon b-beet kbeer.

examples.english: But... the car is not here today!
examples.transliteration: Bas... el sayyara moo hoon el yom!

examples.arabic: قالتلي الجو هون عاصفة قوية وفي رعد وبرق عم يخوفوا
examples.english: She told me the weather here is a strong storm and there is frightening thunder and lightning.
examples.transliteration: Qalatli el jaw hōn 'asifa qawiyya w fi ra'ed w barq 'am yekhawwfu.
